transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hello. Um... I guess I came in because... I just feel like I can't really settle inside my own skin anymore. It's... well, I just always feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing. Even when I'm completely worn out and I know I should just be sitting still. I don't know.
Did this restless feeling start after you began taking or changed the dose of any medication?
No... I haven't started any new medication. Or changed anything.
Does this urge to move primarily affect your legs?
Um... no, I don't think so. It's not... it's not really just my legs. It's just sort of... everywhere, I guess.
Has this feeling of needing to be constantly on the go been with you since childhood?

Um... yes. I suppose it has. Even back in... well, grade school. My teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright, but... careless. I was always losing my papers. And, um, talking out of turn. They always had to remind me to just stay in my seat, or... or finish my work. So... yes.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of different everyday things, to the point where it feels difficult to control?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, I guess, but... no. It's not like that. I wouldn't say it's out of control.
